from fractions import Fraction as F

def in_domain(t):
    return -1 < t < 1

def f_neg(t):
    # lg(q) < 0 iff 0 < q < 1, with q = (1-t)/(1+t), requires domain
    if not in_domain(t):
        return False
    q = (1 - t) / (1 + t)
    return 0 < q < 1

def claimed(x):
    return F(1, 2) < x < 1

# exact grid enumeration over rationals in [-3, 3] with step 1/840
mismatch = []
N = 840
for k in range(-3 * N, 3 * N + 1):
    x = F(k, N)
    t = 2 * x - 1
    if f_neg(t) != claimed(x):
        mismatch.append(x)

# boundary checks
bounds = {x: f_neg(2 * x - 1) for x in [F(0), F(1, 2), F(1), F(3, 4), F(1, 4)]}
print("boundary results (x: f(2x-1)<0):", {str(k): v for k, v in bounds.items()})

# monotonicity (decreasing) sample check on domain using exact fractions
pts = [F(k, 100) for k in range(-99, 100)]
vals = [(1 - p) / (1 + p) for p in pts]  # lg monotonic increasing so compare q
decreasing = all(vals[i] > vals[i + 1] for i in range(len(vals) - 1))
print("q=(1-x)/(1+x) strictly decreasing on sample grid:", decreasing)
print("mismatches:", len(mismatch))

# analytic: q<1 <=> (1-t)<(1+t) (as 1+t>0) <=> t>0 ; so x>1/2; domain t<1 -> x<1
